cohort: 82 pregnant women, 41 with PPROM between 34-37 weeks of gestation and 41 without PPROM (controls), presenting to the maternity unit of Obstetrics and Gynecology Department at Zagazig University Hospitals over an 8-month period.
finding: Expectant management of PPROM after 34 weeks of gestation minimizes maternal risks and reduces neonatal respiratory problems, need for neonatal intensive care, and cesarean sections.
followup_time: up to 4 days after delivery (for maternal outcomes)
